statements.subject: server
statements.description: In this case, the server MUST NOT alter the currently selected newsgroup or current article number.
actions: do not alter currently selected newsgroup
do not alter current article number

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In the response, the article number MUST be replaced with zero, unless there is a currently selected newsgroup and the article is present in that group, in which case the server MAY use the article's number in that group.
actions: set article number to zero in 220 response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In the response, the article number MUST be replaced with zero, unless there is a currently selected newsgroup and the article is present in that group, in which case the server MAY use the article's number in that group.
statements.pre_cond: command.argument_type = message_id & session.selected_newsgroup.valid = true & article.present_in_group = true
actions: optionally set article number to article's number in currently selected newsgroup

statements.subject: client
statements.description: (The server is not required to determine whether the article is in the currently selected newsgroup or, if so, what article number it has; the client MUST always be prepared for zero to be specified.)
actions: accept zero as a valid article number in any ARTICLE response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT provide an article number unless use of that number in a second ARTICLE command immediately following this one would return the same article.
actions: omit non-zero article number from response unless that number would identify the same article in an immediately following ARTICLE command

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Even if the server chooses to return article numbers in these circumstances, it need not do so consistently; it MAY return zero to any such command (also see the STAT examples, Section 6.2.4.3).
statements.pre_cond: command.argument_type = message_id & session.selected_newsgroup.valid = true & article.present_in_group = true
actions: return zero as article number even when group context would permit a real article number

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If there is an article with that number in the currently selected newsgroup, the server MUST set the current article number to that number.
statements.pre_cond: command.argument_type = article_number & session.selected_newsgroup.valid = true & article.exists_in_selected_newsgroup = true
actions: set current article number to the specified article number

statements.subject: nntp
statements.description: Note that a previously valid article number MAY become invalid if the article has been removed.
actions: article number transitions to invalid when article is removed

statements.subject: nntp
statements.description: A previously invalid article number MAY become valid if the article has been reinstated, but this article number MUST be no less than the reported low water mark for that group.
actions: article number may transition to valid when article is reinstated

statements.subject: nntp
statements.description: A previously invalid article number MAY become valid if the article has been reinstated, but this article number MUST be no less than the reported low water mark for that group.
actions: ensure reinstated article number is no less than the reported low water mark for the group

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT change the currently selected newsgroup as a result of this command.
actions: preserve currently selected newsgroup after ARTICLE command completes

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT change the current article number except when an article number argument was provided and the article exists; in particular, it MUST NOT change it following an unsuccessful response.
actions: preserve current article number when article number argument was not provided or article does not exist
preserve current article number following any unsuccessful response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the argument is a message-id and no such article exists, a 430 response MUST be returned.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the argument is a number or is omitted and the currently selected newsgroup is invalid, a 412 response MUST be returned.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the argument is a number and that article does not exist in the currently selected newsgroup, a 423 response MUST be returned.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the argument is omitted and the current article number is invalid, a 420 response MUST be returned.
